sources.author: aapam
patch_list: Removes all AdMob ads (banner, interstitial, rewarded, rewarded interstitial, app open) by intercepting the Corona SDK AdMob plugin bridge before any ad is initialised, loaded, or shown.
Hooks CoronaRuntime.onWillLoadMain() to execute a Lua bootstrap script that stubs in-app purchases (Tienda.ProductoComprado returning 'S'), hides promo/ad UI buttons, and stubs libads.
